rumors.text: The Baron's wig is actually a trained spider.
The local priest accepts donations in copper pieces only.
There's a secret tunnel from the tavern to the castle.
The baker's bread makes you temporarily invisible.
The town well is haunted by a disgruntled water elemental.
Someone's been stealing the left shoe from every pair in town.
The blacksmith is actually a retired dragon in human form.
Every mirror in town shows you 5 years younger.
The local bard is secretly funding the adventurers' guild.
There's a ghost in the library who only haunts bad poetry.
The baker needs yeast from a Giant's cave (Giant is on keto).
Town crier lost his voice. Suspected curse. Needs removal.
Statue in the square changes pose every night. Investigate.
Stray dog is actually a polymorphed noble. Break curse.
Festival prize stolen before judging. Find the thief.
Orphanage needs donations or monster clearing.
Bridge collapse blamed on rust monster. Hunt it.
Local hero's statue coming to life. Contain it.
Baker's bread rising too fast. Yeast elemental in oven?
Town drunk claims he slew a god. Verify or silence.
The miller has been grinding something other than wheat after midnight. The flour tastes faintly of regret.
The innkeeper waters down the ale, but only for people who complain about the ale.
The town's oldest resident is turning 300 next week and still won't say what race she is.
Somebody keeps repainting the 'Welcome' sign to say 'Turn Back.' The handwriting is very neat.
The cobbler's apprentice can talk to rats, and the rats have opinions about the cobbler.
The constable hasn't made an arrest in six years. Crime is either very low or very well organized.
The duck pond is bottomless. Three ducks have confirmed this and not come back.
The widow on Lantern Lane has buried four husbands, and every one of them left her a cursed heirloom.
The tavern's 'secret recipe' stew is whatever the adventurers didn't finish last night.
The church bells ring a thirteenth time at midnight, and only dogs and drunks can hear it.
The schoolteacher is quietly paying off the goblins so they'll skip the schoolhouse during raids.
The night watchman sleeps on duty, but his lantern keeps walking the route without him.
The scarecrow in Farmer Odo's field has been seen voting in the council elections.
The herbalist's 'love tonic' is just strong tea. Her marriage rate is still suspiciously high.
The fountain in the square grants wishes, but only wishes for slightly damp coins.
Two families have feuded for a century over a goat. The goat is still alive.
The gravedigger has been digging one more grave than the town needs every month.
The tavern cat has a tab, and it's paid up.
The new lamplighter only works on nights with no moon, and nobody hired him.
The mayor's portrait blinks during council meetings. Nobody has dared mention it.
The midwife's satchel was stolen with a newborn's true name inside. Get it back before someone uses it.
The town clock stopped at 3:17 and so did everyone's aging. Find out who wound it down.
Chickens keep laying eggs with tiny maps inside. Follow the yolks.
The harvest festival needs a new champion pie judge. The last three were poisoned.
A traveling circus left town but forgot its strongman. He doesn't remember where they were headed.
Somebody is stealing doors. Not what's behind them, just the doors.
Wolves are leaving dead rabbits on the chapel steps like offerings. The priest wants to know who taught them.
The well water turned sweet overnight. The alchemist wants a barrel tested before the children drink more.
The bell tower's bell was replaced with a forgery. The real one is ringing somewhere underground.
A lost child returned from the woods after a week and now speaks only in rhyme. Find out what she met.
Every candle in the chandlery melts into the same shape: a key. Find the lock.
The King is actually three goblins in a trench coat.
The Queen has outlawed the color purple on Tuesdays.
The royal tax collector is a vampire.
The next election will be decided by trial by combat.
The Duke is secretly funding both sides of the war.
The kingdom's borders are shifting 1 inch per day.
The royal advisor is a polymorphed owl.
New law: All dragons must register as small businesses.
The crown prince is missing and nobody's noticed.
The kingdom is actually a simulation created by wizards.
Ambassador needs escort to the border. High pay.
Treaty document stolen from the vault. Retrieve it.
Rebels planning to storm the armory. Stop them.
New law requires all swords to be registered. Enforce it.
Spy network discovered in the post office. Expose them.
King's tax collector is missing. Find him (alive).
Ambassador demands tribute of rare wine. Fetch it.
Election ballots eaten by mimic. Find the mimic.
The High Council's new 'transparency initiative' is a single window, painted shut.
The Lord Treasurer hasn't counted the treasury in years because he's afraid of what he'll find.
The court jester is the only one at court allowed to tell the truth, so the king fired him.
The new tax on chimneys has made smoke a status symbol among the nobility.
The royal food taster has developed an immunity to every poison and now demands a raise.
Both candidates for Guild Speaker are being funded by the same dwarf.
The border wall was finished last month. Someone built a door in it this month.
The Ministry of Roads spent its whole budget on a report about why the roads are bad.
The Duchess has been dead for two years and her decrees keep coming.
The peace treaty with the orc clans was signed in ink that fades after a year. The year is almost up.
The royal heralds now charge by the syllable, so all proclamations are very short and slightly rude.
The Council voted to study whether the Council has too many committees. A committee will report back.
The king's twin brother has been ruling every other week and nobody can tell the difference.
Every new law must now be read aloud in full at the town gate. The gate crier quit after the tax code.
The Elven embassy has been 'arriving soon' for eighty years. By elf standards, that's punctual.
Votes in the last election were counted by a hired ogre. He can count to eleven.
The Lord Chancellor's hat is a hat of disguise. Nobody knows who has been chancellor all this time.
The new 'Ministry of Efficiency' has hired forty clerks to make sure the other ministries aren't hiring too many clerks.
A hedge wizard predicted the next three royal scandals. Two have already happened.
The royal marriage is purely political. The love letters are purely ghostwritten.
The town council meets in the tavern now 'to stay close to the people.' The tab is paid from the road fund.
A senator's signet ring went missing the night before a key vote. Find it before someone seals a law with it.
The king's speechwriter vanished with next week's address. The king is improvising. Please hurry.
Somebody is replacing the tax collectors with polite, helpful doppelgangers. The Treasury wants to know why revenue is up.
Two rival dukes have hired the same assassin. The assassin wants a mediator.
Ballots for the guild election are being eaten by a goat. The goat may have been bribed.
The royal seal has been forged on a decree pardoning every pickpocket in the city. Find the forger.
An exiled noble is hiring bodyguards for a 'quiet' return to court. Pay is high. Quiet is unlikely.
The court astrologer's charts have been tampered with to predict the queen's downfall. Find out by whom.
A treaty must be delivered across three borders in five days. Every border guard has been bribed to lose it.
A minor lord wants proof his rival is a werewolf before the next full moon council.
The parliament's speaking stick was stolen. Without it, nobody is legally allowed to talk. Some call it a blessing.
Riots planned for market day. The mayor wants them stopped. The rioters want their grain back.
Gold pieces are losing value due to dragon hoarding.
The Merchant's Guild is manipulating potion prices.
A new currency made of dragon scales is being introduced.
Healing potions will be rationed next month.
The local bank is actually a lich's phylactery.
Inflation is caused by too many +1 swords in circulation.
The Adventurer's Guild is going public on the Realm Market Exchange.
Magic items are now subject to luxury tax.
A monopoly on torches has been declared illegal.
The price of arrows doubled after a rogue's union strike.
Merchant needs protection from rival guild. Bodyguard duty.
Counterfeit gold pieces circulating. Find the source.
Silk road blocked by giant spiders. Clear the path.
Innkeeper needs help evicting a squatter (it's a lich).
Gem mine flooded with water elementals. Drain it.
Caravan late by two weeks. Send search party.
Smugglers using portable holes. Confiscate them.
Price of steel spikes skyrocketing. Investigate monopoly.
Bank vault door stuck. Need strong party to open.
Silver is up because a vampire lord is quietly buying all of it.
The Moneylenders' Guild now charges interest on the interest on the interest.
Copper coins are being melted down for pots because the pots are worth more than the coins.
A halfling has cornered the market on second breakfasts.
Dungeon real estate is booming. Investors want 'cleared, with original traps.'
The price of rope has tripled. Everyone suspects the adventurers. The adventurers suspect the rope.
A merchant prince is offering shares in a caravan that hasn't left yet, to a city that doesn't exist yet.
Tavern prices go up every time a party of adventurers walks in. The innkeeper calls it 'dynamic pricing.'
The royal mint has been printing coins with the wrong king's face for a month and nobody noticed.
The guild of locksmiths and the guild of thieves share an accountant.
Gem prices dropped after a dwarf hold found 'too many' rubies. The dwarves are hiding the rest.
A gnome invented a coin that's worth exactly what you think it's worth. Banks are furious.
Mercenary wages are down because the goblins are working for scale.
The harbor tariff now applies to 'any vessel,' including flasks. Sailors are smuggling rum in their boots.
A dragon is short-selling the kingdom.
Pawnshops are full of +1 daggers nobody wants. The market for slightly magic cutlery has collapsed.
The new bridge toll costs more than the ferry, which costs more than swimming, which costs a leg if you meet the eels.
Wool is scarce because the sheep are wearing it. A druid is involved.
The bank vault is guarded by a mimic that has started charging its own storage fee.
Every shop in the market raised prices on the same morning. Every shopkeeper swears it was a coincidence.
Guild membership now requires a guild membership, which requires a guild membership.
A merchant is selling 'genuine bottled moonlight.' Sales are excellent on cloudy nights.
A shipment of healing potions arrived with every bottle full of pickle brine. Find out where the real ones went.
A banker needs a 'discreet' escort to move gold between vaults. The gold is fine. The banker is the target.
Someone is flooding the market with counterfeit platinum. The forgeries are better than the real thing.
A caravan master needs guards for a run through goblin country. The goblins want a cut, not a fight.
The spice merchant's ledger is written in a code that changes nightly. The guild will pay to have it cracked.
Debt collectors are vanishing on the road to the old manor. The debtor seems very relaxed about it.
A trading company wants proof its rival is using enchanted scales. Bring evidence, not accusations.
The silk road has a new toll gate run by a very polite ogre. Negotiate, pay, or relocate him.
Dock workers are on strike after a kraken ate the foreman. Management wants it 'resolved.' Workers want a new foreman.
An auction house is selling a 'cursed' painting. The buyer wants to know if it's cursed enough to be worth more.
There's a dungeon under the old mill that's never been cleared.
A legendary sword is hidden in the mayor's basement.
The local quest board hasn't been updated in 50 years.
A party of adventurers went into the forest and never came out.
There's a treasure map tattooed on someone in this tavern.
The ancient ruins glow blue during a full moon.
A wizard is offering 10,000gp for a specific goblin's left ear.
The cursed amulet everyone's seeking is already in town.
There's a portal to the Feywild in the old oak tree.
The dungeon's boss is on vacation until next month.
Cave entrance opened after earthquake. Explore it.
Legendary hero's tomb location deciphered. Loot it.
Quest board has a blank paper that glows. Touch it.
Old mine reopened, miners hearing singing. Silence it.
Treasure chest found floating in river. Retrieve it.
Old temple bell ringing underground. Investigate.
Arena needs new challengers for weekend. Sign up.
Dungeon map sold by a blind beggar. Verify it.
The old lighthouse hasn't had a keeper in a decade, but the light still comes on every night.
There's a vault under the bank that the bank doesn't know about.
A dungeon to the east resets every new moon. The traps re-arm and the loot restocks, but nobody knows who does it.
A map seller in the market only sells maps to places that don't exist yet.
The ruined keep on the hill has a working kitchen and something in it still cooks.
The legendary Sword of Ages was melted down for horseshoes. One horse in the stables is very hard to kill.
Three adventuring parties have claimed the same dragon's hoard. The dragon is still alive and enjoying the drama.
A sunken temple surfaces once a year for exactly one hour. Next surfacing is next week.
The bard's ballad of the Lost Crown has a verse that's actually directions.
A retired adventurer is selling her old gear. One of the boots is still haunted.
The tavern's basement goes down further every time someone checks.
Every adventuring party that hires the local guide comes back. Most of them come back missing one member.
Somewhere in the forest is a door with no walls. Knock three times and you'll be somewhere else.
A wizard's tower appeared overnight on the north road. The wizard seems surprised too.
The abandoned mine has fresh footprints going in and none coming out. The footprints are small.
A dying knight left her shield to 'whoever finishes what I started.' Nobody knows what she started.
A merchant's daughter went missing near the old barrow. The ransom note was signed by a ghost.
Something has been eating the bridge trolls. The trolls would like protection. The town would like to know what eats trolls.
An expedition into the glacier hasn't reported in a month. Their last letter said 'Do not follow.' Pay is double.
A treasure hunter needs a party to retrieve a crown from a crypt she 'definitely didn't trigger the traps in.'
A ship came into harbor with no crew and a full hold. The harbormaster wants to know where they went.
The monastery on the cliff stopped ringing its bells. The road up there has new tracks. Big ones.
An old map shows a dwarven city under the hills. The dwarves say it was abandoned for a reason.
Bandits are robbing travelers and leaving thank-you notes. Find their camp. Return the notes.
A noble's heir needs 'adventuring experience' to inherit. Take him on a quest and bring him back mostly intact.
The island off the coast reappeared after fifty years of fog. The first boat out found an empty town, set for dinner.
A golem is guarding a crossroads and won't let anyone pass without the password. Nobody alive knows it.
Someone stole a famous paladin's horse. The horse is also a paladin.
A haunted inn is for sale cheap. The buyer wants the ghosts evicted, politely, before signing.
A cartographer will pay well for a map of the Shifting Maze. Previous mappers are still in it.
An archaeologist found a tomb sealed from the inside. She needs muscle to open it and courage to look.
Somebody is digging up the old battlefield at night. The bones are being carted somewhere east.
The mountain pass is blocked by an avalanche that keeps rebuilding itself. Dig through or find what's casting it.
A red dragon has been spotted near the northern pass.
Goblins are unionizing and demanding better working conditions.
The local owlbear is actually two animals in a costume.
A beholder is running the local eye clinic.
Werewolves are exempt from the full moon curfew.
The swamp witch accepts payment in memories.
A troll is working as a bouncer at the fancy district.
Dragons now accept cryptocurrency for hoard insurance.
The local mimic population has infiltrated the furniture district.
A mind flayer is running the town's therapy practice.
Wyvern nesting on the bell tower. Remove it.
Ogre demanding toll at the bridge. Negotiate or kill.
Chimera spotted near the sheep pasture. Hunt it.
Kobolds digging under the bank. Stop them.
Griffon attacking mail delivery birds. Ground it.
Troll under bridge wants union rep. Mediate.
Beholder eye stalks found in the market. Find the body.
Druid circle reporting missing treants. Find them.
Goblins selling knock-off healing potions. Raid them.
Displacer beast stealing livestock. Track it.
The kobolds in the hills have elected a dragon as mayor. The dragon doesn't know yet.
A gelatinous cube has been cleaning the sewers for years. The sanitation guild calls it a coworker.
The harpies on the coast have started a choir. Ships are crashing more politely now.
A vampire in the old manor has gone vegetarian. He's very cranky about it.
Owlbears are nesting closer to town every spring. The rangers blame the honey farms.
A hydra has been spotted near the river. It's fine, it's only got one head. For now.
The goblins aren't raiding the farms anymore. They're buying from them. Nobody knows where they got the money.
A lich's phylactery was sold at a yard sale as a 'spooky trinket.' The buyer has been feeling very motivated lately.
Ghouls in the cemetery have formed a book club. They're on chapter two of a cookbook.
The ogre on the toll bridge has a law degree and will argue every coin.
Giant spiders moved into the abandoned silk mill and the silk is excellent now.
Zombies have been seen standing in line outside the healer's. Nobody wants to tell them.
There's a dragon living under the tavern. That's why the floor is always warm.
The lake monster is real, but it's shy and the 'sightings' are just a very large carp.
Gnolls are trading hyena pups at the border market. Several nobles have bought one. Several nobles are missing fingers.
A banshee in the old keep only wails on tax day. Locals call it reasonable.
The basilisk at the menagerie is wearing a blindfold. The statues around its pen are former keepers.
A medusa opened a sculpture gallery. Critics praise the realism.
The minotaur in the labyrinth is tired of the maze and just wants a map like everyone else.
Something is eating sheep and leaving the wool folded neatly. Find it and ask about its manners.
A wyvern nested on the cathedral spire. The bishop wants it moved before the holy day.
Trolls are regenerating faster than the watch can burn them. Find the source of the fire-proofing.
A hag is offering farmers a 'better harvest' for a small favor. Find out what the favor is.
Rats in the granary are organized, armed, and demanding grain. A wererat is suspected.
A young dragon has claimed the old watchtower and is charging rent. Evict it, negotiate, or pay up.
Will-o'-wisps are leading travelers off the marsh road. The last missing traveler was carrying the payroll.
A manticore is terrorizing the southern pass and taunting the guards by name. Someone told it their names.
The ghost of a jilted bride haunts the chapel every wedding. The couple getting married next week wants her gone.
A chimera escaped a wizard's menagerie and its three heads disagree about where to go.
Stirges are swarming the vineyards. The winemaker says this year's vintage is 'full-bodied.'
A gorgon has been seen grazing in the royal pastures. The royal livestock are now very still.
Casting fireball indoors is now a misdemeanor.
The local wizard's tower has more floors on the inside.
Potions expire after 30 days and turn into poison.
There's a spell that can make your hair grow back instantly.
The archmage is actually 12 gnomes in a robe.
Magic missiles are causing a shortage of small birds.
Scrolls of resurrection come with a 30-day money-back guarantee.
The local ley lines are causing WiFi interference.
A cursed mirror shows you your alternate universe self.
Teleportation circles require a subscription service now.
Wild magic zone appeared in the park. Contain it.
Potion shop exploded, need cleanup crew. Hazard pay.
Scroll of resurrection found in a gutter. Return it.
Wizard tower floating away slowly. Anchor it.
Enchanted sword won't stop singing. Disenchant it.
Potion of invisibility stuck permanent. Fix it.
Teleportation circle sending people to wrong city. Repair it.
Cursed mirror trapping reflections. Break it.
Apprentice turned himself into a teapot. Reverse it.
Magic broom sweeping uncontrollably. Stop it.
The wizard's college failed its accreditation because half the faculty are illusions.
A love potion is going around that only works on people who already liked you, which is technically still a love potion.
Every apprentice's first fireball sets their eyebrows on fire. It's considered a rite of passage.
A spell of perfect memory exists, but everyone who casts it forgets where they wrote it down.
The enchanter on Bell Street sells 'glowing' swords that are just very well-polished.
Scrolls bought at the night market have a habit of being in a language the buyer can't read.
A wish was granted last month. Nobody will admit to it, but the town has a lot more geese.
Prestidigitation is banned in the bakery after an apprentice flavored every loaf like cinnamon.
Somewhere in the city is a door that only opens for people who've never lied. It's been closed for ninety years.
The alchemist's guild accidentally invented a potion of mild inconvenience. It's selling well as a prank gift.
The moon is slowly being enchanted by someone with a very long ladder.
Magic users have to register their familiars now. The cats are refusing to sign.
A sorcerer sneezed and turned the town hall purple. That's why the Queen outlawed the color.
Wands sold in the market come pre-charged, mostly with lint.
The library's restricted section restricts itself. Books move away from people who aren't ready.
The archmage's tower has a waiting list of apprentices that goes back three generations.
A cantrip has been discovered that makes your boots never get wet. The cobblers want it suppressed.
Identify spells cost more this season because 'everyone's finding things.'
A crystal ball in the pawnshop only shows the future of the pawnshop.
An apprentice summoned something and can't unsummon it. It's polite but won't leave.
All the mirrors in the mage's guild show a room that isn't there. Find the room.
A wizard died mid-spell and the spell is still going. Half of his street is in last Tuesday.
A spellbook was stolen from the academy. It contains a spell that should never be cast twice.
Rain falling on the north district is coming down upward. The weather mage is on holiday.
Magic items in town are going dim one by one. Something is drinking the enchantments.
A portal opened in the town square and only cats come through it. Thousands of cats.
The city's ward stones are cracking. The mages say it's fine. The mages are packing.
A bard's song is cursed. Everyone who hums it ends up in the same cave.
Shadows in the merchant quarter are detaching and wandering off. Find out where they go.
A retired wizard wants her old tower cleared of everything she 'left running.'
Someone is selling resurrection scrolls that bring back the wrong person.
